title: SigningResponse
description: Vault/pipeline answer to a signing request, carrying the terminal (or current) lifecycle state and refusal reasons. Never contains key material; the signature appears only as the broadcastable artifact (or, for typed_data/personal_message, the raw signature). v1.1: signing_request_id is nullable — null means the request was refused before a Vault signing request existed (validation/permission/policy refusal); found via the browser-connect conformance harness. v1.2: optional review_evidence — display-only pipeline evidence (decoded intent, simulation outcome, risk findings, policy verdict/reasons) so consumer UIs can show why the wallet decided; it carries no authority and is never consumed by any wallet decision path. v1.3 (protocol v0.4, additive): optional signature_hex carries the raw ECDSA signature for typed_data/personal_message requests, which terminate at state=SIGNED (no broadcast step exists for a signature-only request — that is a legitimate, not partial, success state for those kinds).

signing_request_id.description: null = refused before a Vault signing request existed

tx_hash.description: null = signed/attempted but hash unknown; absent = not applicable (e.g. typed_data/personal_message, which carry signature_hex instead)

signature_hex.description: v1.3: present iff a typed_data/personal_message signature was produced (65-byte r/s/v). Absent for evm_transaction requests and for any refusal.

audit_head_sequence.description: audit-log sequence number of the last event for this request — lets callers reference the auditable trail

review_evidence.description: v1.2, display-only: pipeline evidence summary for consumer UIs. Strings only; no authority, no override hooks. Absent when the request was refused before an intent was decoded.

decoded_action.description: decoded action kind (+ function signature when known)

simulation.description: simulation outcome + standing-limitation count; absent = simulation never ran

risk_level.description: aggregated risk level; UNKNOWN is spelled out, never softened

policy_verdict.description: Allow | Escalate | Deny; absent = policy never ran
